About Thread

A working MVP for routine guidance and memory support. Connect an OpenAI API key to use live AI. Without a key, basic commands remain available.

Saved app data stays in this browser. AI requests send relevant saved context and any attached photo to OpenAI. Care requests appear in Care circle and other tabs on this device; they do not send messages or call anyone.

Voice input uses your browser’s speech service, which may process audio remotely. It starts only when you press the microphone. Photos are selected explicitly, sent only with your message, and not saved in the activity log.

This prototype has not been tested as a medical or emergency service, or validated on Meta glasses.
